净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Mutation of attentive sales yield: added rolling winsorization (5th/95th percentile over 60-day window) to the product of sales yield and inattention. This reduces extreme values that weaken linear correlation (IC) while preserving the strong rank ordering (RankIC, RankICIR) and nonlinear dependence (MI). The core mechanism remains: value (sales yield) amplified when turnover is low (inattention).

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

clip( (1/ps_ttm) * (1 - ts_rank(free_turn, 20)), rolling 5th/95th pctl 60d )
依赖列: ps_ttm, free_turn

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

clip( (1/ps_ttm) * (1 - ts_rank(free_turn, 20)), rolling 5th/95th pctl 60d )
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. clip —— 裁剪到区间[下限,上限]
    clip(divide(1, ps_ttm), 0.01, 0.99)
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(1, ps_ttm)
使用字段：
列含义说明
ps_ttmps_ttm（中间变量/衍生量）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 sales_yield：1.0 / ps_ttm
  2. 计算 inattention：1.0 - free_turn.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=1).rank(pct=True)
  3. 计算 sales_yield：sales_yield.ffill()
  4. 计算 inattention：inattention.ffill()
  5. 计算 raw：sales_yield * inattention
  6. 计算 low：raw.滚动窗口(60, min_periods=10).quantile(0.05)
  7. 计算 high：raw.滚动窗口(60, min_periods=10).quantile(0.95)
  8. 计算 winsorized：raw.clip(lower=low, upper=high)

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_attentive_sales_yield_winsorized(df): df_copy = df.copy() sales_yield = 1.0 / df_copy["ps_ttm"].replace(0, np.nan) inattention = 1.0 - df_copy["free_turn"].rolling(20, min_periods=1).rank(pct="kw">class="kw">True) sales_yield = sales_yield.ffill() inattention = inattention.ffill() raw = sales_yield * inattention low = raw.rolling(60, min_periods=10).quantile(0.05) high = raw.rolling(60, min_periods=10).quantile(0.95) winsorized = raw.clip(lower=low, upper=high) df_copy["factor_attentive_sales_yield_winsorized"] = winsorized "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_attentive_sales_yield_winsorized"]
